facts.fact: The New Times reports that the Ministry of Education has rolled out a new digital attendance tracking system, expected to reduce dropouts by identifying learners at risk early; the rollout is undated, so the document's published date is used.
The New Times says the digital attendance tracking system was rolled out by the Ministry of Education; undated, so the document's published date is used.
The New Times lead reports the attendance tracking system as rolled out and gives no count or share of schools; only the lead of the article was captured, and the document's published date is used.

note: Only the article's lead was captured (75 words): it does not say who enters attendance, how often, at which levels or in how many schools. Classed emis on its tracking attendance to identify individual learners at risk.
